text: You're looking for a high-protein dish that fits within your 45-minute time frame and aligns with your vegan dietary preferences. This Scrambled Tofu recipe checks all those boxes. With 15 grams of protein per serving, it should help you meet your health goal. The combination of tofu, nutritional yeast, and spices provides a rich and savory flavor profile, while the mushrooms and onion add depth and texture. This recipe is also quick to prepare, making it a great option for a busy day.
